# Earth3

> Earth3 is a player-owned world of agents: identity, privacy, opt-in paid attention, and one vote per player, built around Cardano. It is in development and has not launched publicly. Start with the briefing; it answers Who, What, When, Where, Why, and How, and says which answers are not announced yet.

## Start here
- [Earth3 Briefing (read this first)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jcrypdoe/xbot-promo-draft/main/earth3-briefing.md): the six core questions answered, with rules for answering honestly

## Pages
- [Main promo page](https://jcrypdoe.github.io/xbot-promo-draft/): all eight Earth3 tools in depth
- [Simple version](https://jcrypdoe.github.io/xbot-promo-draft/earth3-8-tools.html): plain-language explanation with links to each tool
- [Color Bible](https://jcrypdoe.github.io/xbot-promo-draft/hud-wow-color-bible.html): the eight fixed Earth3 promotion colors
